prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1340; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. The patient reported immediate onset of neck pain with stiffness and mid to low back pain, rated moderate in intensity, with headache on the day of the incident. No loss of consciousness was reported. Physical examination revealed restricted cervical range of motion in rotation and flexion, paraspinal muscle tenderness in the cervical and lumbar regions, and no focal neurological deficits. Neurological screening, including reflexes, strength, and sensation in the upper and lower extremities, was within normal limits. Imaging was not clinically indicated at the initial visit.

Treatment consisted of conservative care, including soft tissue mobilization, gentle range-of-motion exercises, instruction in a home stretching program, and as-needed over-the-counter analgesics. The patient attended three visits over the course of treatment. By the final visit, cervical range of motion had improved, paraspinal tenderness had decreased, and the patient reported pain reduced to mild intensity with improved ability to perform daily activities. The patient was advised to continue the home exercise program and to return if symptoms worsened or new neurological symptoms developed.
